papers.title: Identifying strain localization and dislocation processes in fatigued Inconel 718 manufactured from selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, 771 Ferst Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30332-0245, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Yung Suk Jeremy Yoo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, 771 Ferst Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30332-0245, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造Inconel 718的疲劳行为，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover biomedical implant materials, porous structures for osseointegration, or stress shielding, and the material (Inconel 718) is not used for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造Inconel 718的疲劳损伤机制
summary_zh.method: 结合电子显微镜和数字图像相关识别应变局部化
summary_zh.result: 表征了应变局部化和位错过程
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳实验和显微观察进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand fatigue damage mechanisms in Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Combined electron microscopy and digital image correlation to identify strain localization and dislocation processes.
summary_en.result: Strain localization and dislocation processes were characterized in fatigued specimens.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental fatigue testing and post-mortem microscopy.

papers.title: Additive manufacturing of a novel Ti-Al-V-Fe alloy using selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, McMaster University, Hamilton, Ontario, L8S 4L7, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: A.B. Phillion
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, McMaster University, Hamilton, Ontario, L8S 4L7, Canada

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文开发了一种新型Ti-Al-V-Fe合金的SLM工艺，但未涉及多孔结构设计、应力遮挡或疲劳性能等核心关注点。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on alloy synthesis and process optimization, not on porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种可用于选区激光熔化的新型钛合金成分
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备合金并进行微观结构和力学性能表征
summary_zh.result: 新型Ti-Al-V-Fe合金表现出良好的工艺性和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和显微分析验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a novel titanium alloy composition suitable for selective laser melting in additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized for microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The new Ti-Al-V-Fe alloy demonstrates improved processability and mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis were conducted for validation.

papers.title: Thermofluid field of molten pool and its effects during selective laser melting (SLM) of Inconel 718 alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Beijing Engineering Research Center of 3D Printing for Digital Medical Health, Beijing University of Technology, Pingleyuan No. 100, Chaoyang Dist., Beijing, 100124, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongyun Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Engineering Research Center of 3D Printing for Digital Medical Health, Beijing University of Technology, Pingleyuan No. 100, Chaoyang Dist., Beijing, 100124, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718合金选区激光熔化的熔池热流场，与生物医学植入物AM方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure design, no mechanical testing, no fatigue or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化Inconel 718合金的熔池热流场特性
summary_zh.method: 采用数值模拟方法分析熔池温度场和流场
summary_zh.result: 揭示了熔池热流场对成形质量的影响机制
summary_zh.validation: 仅基于仿真，缺乏实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the thermofluid field characteristics of the molten pool during selective laser melting of Inconel 718 alloy.
summary_en.method: Numerical simulation was employed to analyze the temperature and flow fields within the molten pool.
summary_en.result: The study revealed the influence mechanisms of the thermofluid field on the forming quality.
summary_en.validation: Validation relied solely on simulation without experimental confirmation.
